epistemicBoundary: This record uses only explicit user-reported burden plus repository/runtime observations. It does not infer wellbeing, meaning, identity, stress, love, or financial benefit from system activity.

baseline.source: explicit user report during first-fruit methodology critique

current.observation: One Flower prompt now routinely initiates multiple GitHub reads/writes, external checks, falsification passes, and follow-on research without another human clock pulse. No exact minutes-saved claim is made.

humanAttention.why: The manual pulse requirement has visibly fallen, matching a failure condition the user explicitly named. Exact time savings remain unmeasured.

observations: Flower rejected Storybook indexing after lifecycle math showed no gain.
Flower weakened naive crystallization after external AgentTrace recurrence failed transformation-equivalence checks.
Flower abandoned an MCP handshake optimization after current upstream protocol evidence showed the bottleneck had been removed.
These are evidence of better methodology decisions; their personal-life value to the Center-holder has not yet been independently quantified.

completionClosure.why: Repository research has closed several methodology branches, but no sufficient before/after evidence yet shows that major external personal/work obligations are being completed faster because of Flower.

financialUtility.why: No settled financial return attributable to Flower has been verified. Projected opportunity value is not counted.

observations: A durable GitHub methodology/kernel now exists.
The repository contains reusable observatories, value-gradient witnesses, control-plane research, transfer tests, and a Center Dividend audit.
Whether this optionality improves the Center-holder's lived freedom requires future use evidence rather than repository count.

meaningWellbeing.why: No claim is permitted without explicit Center-holder testimony for this observation window.

allocationImplication.current: Continue bounded methodology improvement only when it also advances one of three external dividends: reduced Center-holder burden, independently useful transfer evidence, or verified economic/personal-world progress.
allocationImplication.antiLoopRule: A methodology improvement that produces only more methodology artifacts and no measurable decision, burden, transfer, or external-value gain should increasingly lose allocation priority.
allocationImplication.nextBestPersonalWitness: Apply Flower to one real unresolved Center-holder obligation and compare time-to-closure, human attention, decision quality, and outcome against the prior/manual process.
